title: Counting on Dummies: Privacy Amplification with Observable Counts and Truncated Batches
abstract: arXiv:2610.42139v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many practical deployments of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD), the server processes data in batches. Randomly sampling these batches allows for better privacy bounds via privacy amplification results. Most sampling schemes with provable privacy amplification, including Poisson sampling and random allocation, result in variable batch sizes. The privacy guarantee of these schemes requires that the batch sizes are not revealed. In distributed settings, the server performing the aggregation or any party observing the communication traffic may learn these batch sizes. Furthermore, in both centralized and distributed settings, memory and computation constraints may require each batch to be of some maximum size $s$, necessitating truncation of the batch when it exceeds this limit. It is known that this truncation can result in a significant increase in privacy loss. In this work, we address both of these challenge

translated_title: 依靠虚拟样本：具有可观测计数与截断批次的隐私放大
translated_abstract: 在差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）的许多实际部署中，服务器以批次方式处理数据。通过随机采样这些批次，可以借助隐私放大结果获得更好的隐私界。大多数具有可证明隐私放大的采样方案，包括泊松采样和随机分配，都会导致批次大小可变，而这些方案的隐私保证要求批次大小不被泄露。在分布式设置中，执行聚合的服务器或任何观察通信流量的参与方都可能获知这些批次大小。此外，在集中式和分布式设置中，内存和计算约束可能要求每个批次具有某个最大尺寸 s，当批次超过此限制时必须进行截断。众所周知，这种截断可能导致隐私损失的显著增加。在本工作中，我们同时解决这两个挑战（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于虚拟样本填充的方法，使DP-SGD的隐私放大在批次大小可被观测以及批次因超过最大尺寸而被截断的情况下依然有效，从而解决了实际部署中的两大隐私挑战。
